paragraphs: I'm applying for the Product Management Intern role for Winter 2027. I'm an MBA (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Gemini's focus on building crypto products that regular users can trust is what draws me in, and the January to April timing fits my last semester well.

At Lenovo I documented business requirements and turned stakeholder needs into dashboards for campaign initiatives, which improved campaign ROI by 20%. I also owned the mapping and QA for AI-powered dashboards with real-time metrics, which cut reporting time by 4+ hours a week. At JPMorgan Asset Management I built analytics frameworks to track KPIs across platforms, which helped deliver a 135% increase in engagements while reducing media spend by up to 83%.

The posting asks for structured problem-solving and a data foundation. That's how I've worked: listen to the people who use the product, define the problem, then check the data before deciding. I'd be glad to bring that to your team in the office this winter, and I'd welcome the chance to talk.
